_doc: Duke Strategies terminology — the BRAND layer. See
clients/_default/voice/terminology.json for what this file is and who reads it.
PROVENANCE (2026-09-08). Derived by measuring, not by guessing: all 21 values
that are byte-identical between src/i18n/content/ui.en.ts and ui.nl.ts on the
live Duke site were read one by one. Every one of them turned out to be
CORRECT Dutch — brand names, or English the Dutch public-affairs register
keeps. So this file is not a list of defects to fix; it is the record that
stops a future translator from 'fixing' them into worse Dutch.
Deliberately NOT recorded: values that are simply the same word in both
languages and carry no decision — Contact, Home, Sitemap, 'Context:',
'Team:', 'Crisis & Media'. A termbase entry should represent a judgement
someone made, not a coincidence of vocabulary.
Dutch general register (workflow, stakeholder, roadmap, …) is inherited from
the nl seed and is not repeated here.

nl.rationale: Product name. 'Duke Academie' is the plausible mistake this entry exists to catch.
Kept wholesale in the Dutch communications register. 'Opinieleiderschap' is understood but reads as a translation.
Service-line name. 'stakeholder' is kept in Dutch anyway (see the nl register seed); translating only the second half would produce a hybrid.
Job title, used untranslated in Dutch professional-services firms.
Duke's own title for its senior network. A name, not a description.

Common in the Dutch consulting register, but 'op te leveren werk' is also correct and Dutch closes the compound with the loanword as the TAIL, which keep-source cannot enforce. Recorded as 'either' deliberately rather than as a rule that would fail on correct copy.
